facts.text: Rocco Forte House Rome's private apartments are within an 18th-century palazzo at Piazza di Spagna.
facts.excerpt: At Piazza di Spagna, five palatial private apartments within an 18th-century palazzo.

facts.text: A stately roof terrace above the apartments surveys the Spanish Steps.
facts.excerpt: Above, a stately roof terrace surveying the Spanish Steps.

facts.text: The interiors are designed by Tommaso Ziffer.
facts.excerpt: Inside, elegant, opulent design by Tommaso Ziffer.

facts.text: A dedicated house manager is on hand.
facts.excerpt: A dedicated house manager on hand.

facts.text: Guests have access to the spa, the bars and the Fulvio Pierangelini restaurants of Hotel de la Ville.
facts.excerpt: Unbridled access to the spa, the bars and Fulvio Pierangelini restaurants of Hotel de la Ville.

facts.text: The address is 114 Via del Babuino, Piazza di Spagna, Rome.
facts.excerpt: 114 Via del Babuino

facts.text: Amenities include access to the rooftop terrace and an Honesty Bar.
facts.excerpt: Access to rooftop terrace and Honesty Bar

facts.text: Guests get complimentary access to the Irene Forte Spa and fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary access to Irene Forte Spa and fitness center

facts.text: A welcome hamper of Italian specialties is included on arrival for stays of 7 nights or more.
facts.excerpt: Welcome hamper on arrival, with a selection of Italian specialties (included for a stay of 7 nights or more)

facts.text: Rocco Forte House city bikes are among the amenities.
facts.excerpt: Rocco Forte House city bikes

facts.text: Each apartment has a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Fully equipped kitchen

facts.text: Daily housekeeping and a House Concierge are included services.
facts.excerpt:
- House Concierge
- Daily housekeeping

facts.text: A private chef and a breakfast basket delivered to the apartment are available at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt:
- Breakfast basket delivered to your apartment
- Private chef

facts.text: Private butler service is available by the hour, by the day, or for the full stay, at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt: Private butler service available by the hour, by the day, or full stay

facts.text: A nanny service is available at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt: Nanny service

facts.text: Small pets under 6kg are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Amenities for your pet (we welcome small pets under 6kg)

facts.text: The Bernini apartments are inspired by the Baroque sculptor Bernini.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the famous Baroque sculptor, our second and third-floor Bernini apartments each comprise two spacious ensuite bedrooms.

facts.text: Tall windows in the Bernini apartments look over Piazza di Spagna and the Spanish Steps.
facts.excerpt: Tall windows offer guests a wonderful view over the Piazza di Spagna and the Spanish Steps.

facts.text: The third-floor Bernini apartment has a four poster bed and walk-in wardrobe.
facts.excerpt: The third-floor apartment has a spectacular four poster bed and walk-in wardrobe

facts.text: The Piranesi apartments are named after the Piranesi family and have original heritage features.
facts.excerpt: Named after the renowned Piranesi family, the second and third-floor Piranesi apartments each comprise two double-bedrooms which open onto ambient living quarters accented with striking patterns, artwork and original heritage features.

facts.text: The Piranesi apartments look out over Via del Babuino.
facts.excerpt: Elegant windows fill the interiors with natural light and offer sweeping views of Via del Babuino.

facts.text: The Borghese apartment connects the Piranesi and Bernini apartments and is suited to groups.
facts.excerpt: this four-bedroom apartment connects our Piranesi and Bernini apartments with unrivalled views across Piazza di Spagna and Via del Babuino, creating the perfect home for groups visiting Rome.

facts.text: The Spagna Penthouse is on the fourth floor and has a private terrace.
facts.excerpt: this two-bedroom penthouse is perched on the fourth floor with a breath-taking 108 sq. m. private terrace

facts.text: The penthouse terrace has panoramic views of Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti and suits alfresco eating.
facts.excerpt: opens onto a sun-drenched terrace ideal for alfresco eating backdropped by panoramic views of the Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti

facts.text: Bathrooms are Italian marble with free-standing baths and showers.
facts.excerpt: Both bedrooms provide super king-sized beds and Italian marble bathrooms, free-standing baths, showers and double wash basins

facts.text: There is no restaurant on site.
facts.excerpt: There’s no restaurant on-site, but all apartments come with a private chef on call, and the manager can get your fridge stocked with groceries, too.

facts.text: Designer Tommaso Ziffer is Rome-based and known for his work with Valentino.
facts.excerpt: Rome-based designer Tommaso Ziffer, known for his work with fashion house Valentino, has pulled the suites together with a mishmash of eclectic antiques, opulent Italian fabrics, and bold 1970s decor.

facts.text: The property is between Piazza di Spagna and Via del Babuino.
facts.excerpt: You’re smack dab in the center of it all here, between Piazza di Spagna and Via del Babuino.

facts.text: Due to the 18th-century building design, Condé Nast Traveler says it is not suitable for wheelchair users.
facts.excerpt: Due to the 18th-century building design, Rocco Forte House isn’t suitable for wheelchair users.

facts.text: The second-floor Bernini apartment has a studio accessible for disabled guests.
facts.excerpt: the second-floor apartment has an additional studio which is accessible for disabled guests and can be converted into an additional bedroom

facts.text: The manager will add toddler beds and cots to the apartment on request.
facts.excerpt: The manager will happily add extra toddler beds and cots to your apartment

facts.text: Rome is the first opening of the Rocco Forte House concept.
facts.excerpt: The Rocco Forte House concept is the latest offering from luxury hotel brand Rocco Forte, and Rome is the first opening.

facts.text: Check-in is smooth and discreet, with bags taken to the apartment.
facts.excerpt: Check-in is smooth and discreet, your bags whisked to your apartment before you’ve even opened the door.

facts.text: Guests are welcome at sister properties Hotel de Russie and Hotel de la Ville for restaurants, bars and spas.
facts.excerpt: Guests are welcome to head down to sister properties

contradictions.note: p2 and p4 say the Bernini second-floor and Borghese apartments are accessible for disabled guests; p6 (CNT) says the House isn't suitable for wheelchair users
